``` All four items shipped. Here is what changed.

**1. Small prices (utils.ts)**
`formatUsdcPrice` now has two branches. At $0.01 and above it uses `Intl.NumberFormat` with 2 dp as before. Below $0.01 it computes the number of leading zeros after the decimal point, adds 2 for two significant digits, caps at 6 dp, and returns a plain `$` string. So 350 micro-USDC → `$0.00035`, 12 micro-USDC → `$0.000012`. Exactly zero still returns `$0.00`. All the call sites (deal room hero, tier chips, activity, deal cards, proof page) pick up the fix automatically because they all call `formatUsdcPrice`. The Sell page price inputs already accepted 6 dp via `step="0.000001"` from a prior turn; no change needed there.

**2. Copy button (copyText.ts + DealRoom.tsx)**
`src/swarm/copyText.ts` tries `navigator.clipboard.writeText` first, then falls back to a hidden textarea with `document.execCommand('copy')`, returning `true`/`false`. The DealRoom share button now uses it: on success it shows "Copied.", on failure "Couldn't copy — the link is selected." in amber (the link is selected in the textarea fallback so the user can Ctrl+C manually).

**3. Seller can't order / duplicate closed card (DealRoom.tsx + CommitFlow.tsx)**
`DealRoom` reads `useAccount` and compares `deal.supplier` to `address` case-insensitively. When they match (`isSupplier`), the right card shows the short note ("This is your deal. Buyers' orders appear in the activity below.") in place of CommitFlow, and the secondary-buttons strip is hidden. The settle/refund and claim panels above the card continue to render normally for the supplier. The duplicate "This deal is closed." guard in `CommitFlow` is replaced with `return null` — `DealRoom` already shows the informative `SettleOrRefundPanel` or `ClaimPanel` in that state, so the bare text was redundant.

**4. Your deals tab (DealList.tsx + App.tsx)**
`DealListTab` is now `'active' | 'ended' | 'yours'` (exported). `DealList` gains a `walletAddr` prop. A third `useReadContracts` batch calls `unitsOf(dealId, walletAddr)` for every deal whenever a wallet is connected. The "Your deals" tab is inserted into the pill bar only when `walletAddr` is set. The `yours` computed list filters to deals where `supplier === walletAddr` or `myUnits > 0`, sorted newest-first. In that tab each card gets a role badge ("Selling" or "Joined · N units") and settled/refunded deals get a green "Ready to collect" highlight with a green border. Empty state says "Deals you post or join show up here." The token filter pills are hidden on the "yours" tab.

**5. Wallet chip with copy (App.tsx)**
`ConnectKitButton` is replaced with `WalletChip`. When disconnected it renders a plain `ConnectKitButton`. When connected it renders: a chip (avatar circle + short address, click opens the ConnectKit modal via `useModal`) plus a small copy-icon button (sm and up only) that calls `copyText(address)` with a tick feedback. On 375 px phones only the chip avatar is visible (short address hidden via `hidden sm:inline`), keeping the header fitting.
